description:
A brilliant, easy way to test your spelling. Ask ChatGPT to suggest the words, and this app displays a test widget for you to try spelling them.

e.g. 

- "@Bee Spelling, give me a quick test"
- "Test me on some hard words @Bee Spelling"
- "Test my @Bee Spelling with 20 nature words"
